digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler / ticket store / multi-project support
propositions: Bridge is hard-wired to a single tracker project at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair derivation, and applier outbound mutation guard, preventing teams from syncing multiple projects to one shared store

Store-owned project-to-repos mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json decouples projects from repos, allowing N projects and N repos to sync against one shared snapshot without each repo falsely detecting the others' projects as remote deletions

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate all configured projects for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps), merging results by issue key to preserve enrichment fidelity per project

Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy-default, empty=never-sync, explicit-key=sync-there) and promote-only (immutable after binding), with zero-event idempotent migration seeding legacy defaults from per-repo backend.project

Multi-project store must carry multi-project-bridge capability stamp in .store-compat.json required_capabilities; older binaries fail closed on multi-project stores while single-project stores remain backward-compatible

Outbound mutations must verify target project set membership rather than exact equality, with empty-project tickets producing zero mutations and explicit-project tickets targeting their recorded project instead of repo default
